function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "Go to vaccine manufacturers." They likely want information about vaccine manufacturers? Or maybe they want me to navigate somewhere? As an AI text-based assistant I cannot physically go anywhere but can provide info or direct them.

We need to interpret what they mean. Possibly they want a list of major vaccine manufacturers worldwide. Provide details like companies, vaccines produced, etc. Could also ask clarifying question if ambiguous. But we should respond with helpful answer.

Thus produce overview of key vaccine manufacturers (Pfizer-BioNTech, Moderna, Johnson & Johnson, AstraZeneca, Novavax, Sinovac, SinoPharm, Bharat Biotech, Serum Institute India). Include their notable products, technology platforms, production capacity, global reach. Also mention emerging players.

Also could include links to websites. Since no browsing allowed except via tool; but we have ability to use search_google. We might browse up-to-date data. Let's do quick search for "major COVID-19 vaccine manufacturers". Use search_google.
